lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular nodes arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with larger, more isolated spots appearing further along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a grid-like intersection pattern on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running parallel along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four parallel, vertically-oriented linear marks or lacerations located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, exhibiting darker pixel values than the surrounding dermis.
other_distinctive_markers: A large remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the dorsal surface, partially occluding the area where the first dorsal fin would typically be visible.
